stemMd: A positive integer has prime factorisation 2 squared times 3 times 5 cubed. How many distinct prime factors does it have?
explanationMd: Distinct prime factors are the different prime bases: 2,3,5. Exponents record repetitions, so they do not increase the distinct count beyond three.

distractorRationale.d: This is the divisor count, not the number of distinct primes.
distractorRationale.b: This counts prime factors with multiplicity.
distractorRationale.e: This is the product of distinct prime factors.
distractorRationale.c: This multiplies exponents rather than counting bases.
